content_value: Between Biaxial and Uniaxial Geogrid and Cellular Confinement Technologies, Geosynthetics Have Been at the Forefront of Soil Stabilization Applications Since 1959.

Successful civil and geotechnical projects require more than geosynthetic products. Industrial Fabrics, Inc. provides engineered solutions, technical expertise, and professional engineering support to help engineers and contractors meet project specifications, improve soil stabilization and reinforcement, reduce construction costs, and deliver durable, cost-effective infrastructure with long-term performance.

The BaseLok® team provides professional engineering support, technical expertise, and advanced geosynthetic design software. From initial design and material selection to construction support, our Professional Engineers (P.E.) and technical specialists help optimize specifications, reduce project costs, and improve long-term infrastructure performance.

BaseLok<sup>®</sup> geogrids and geocells provide engineered soil stabilization and reinforcement solutions for unpaved roads, heavy-haul routes, industrial laydown yards, and weak subgrades. Backed by peer-reviewed Texas A&M University research, decades of field experience, and millions of square yards installed, BaseLok<sup>®</sup> delivers proven solutions for civil infrastructure projects.

BaseLok<sup>®</sup> provides engineered geogrid stabilization solutions for temporary working platforms, crane pads, and heavy equipment access over weak soils. Our Professional Engineering team uses proven geotechnical design methods to optimize bearing capacity, reduce aggregate thickness by 30% or more where conditions permit, and lower construction costs for demanding projects.

BaseLok<sup>®</sup> GeoCell provides engineered erosion control and slope stabilization for steep slopes, drainage channels, and shorelines. Designed for demanding hydraulic conditions, this cellular confinement system supports concrete, vegetation, and aggregate infill. Our Professional Engineers provide site-specific design assistance to optimize hydraulic performance, soil stability, and long-term erosion protection.
